gloss: to be convinced; to understand; to make sense

definitions.gloss: to be convinced; to understand; to make sense
definitions.explanation: To fully understand and accept something, often after initial doubt or confusion. Implies that something clicks or falls into place. Frequently used in the negative to express that something is hard to accept.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{合点|がてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合点|がてん}が{行|い}かない。
⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、ようやく{合点|がてん}が{行|い}く⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After hearing the circumstances, I was finally able to make sense of it.

notes:
USAGE:
Very often used in the negative: {合点|がてん}が{行|い}かない (I can't accept that / that doesn't make sense). The negative form expresses dissatisfaction or disagreement with an explanation or situation. The positive form {合点|がてん}が{行|い}く suggests that something has finally become clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合点|がてん}が{行|い}かない (to not be convinced, to not make sense)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{合点|がてん}が{行|い}く (to finally understand)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}する→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧: to be convinced, to accept — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる→腑に落ちる：09908_funiochiru⟧: to make sense, to click — similar expression implying deep understanding
